spec.command: bash -c "source /etc/network_turbo && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/scripts/libero_object_full_pipeline.py 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/results/libero_object/pipeline.log"

experiment_data.hypothesis: The convergent entry-exit routing architecture (inverted-U R² profile, instruction-dominant L1 heads, counterfactual sensitivity) observed in OpenVLA on LIBERO-Goal generalizes to LIBERO-Object tasks, demonstrating that VLA fine-tuning produces consistent representational reorganization across different task types (object manipulation vs goal-directed).
